content: Tsahad Yeeso ha aten ɓǝlla kakhrha
Tǝrgha malgha Yeeso Kafarnahum, ɗǝgha chehweed Yahuda ɗǝ tǝ pǝm kufad Urdun. Nggǝrgha fiya naarha wumnda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa, tsahanggǝn kanda ha ƙǝla nǝn tǝ ǝnaarha.
Ɓagha fingya Farisaya ɓa na mindan sǝ a ɗǝfang takthleera nda. Tsahang mee nda ha, ndang ngganda, “Pǝranggǝn kan, ahu ngyahad nǝm mǝmǝlni a kalgha niifa nukkun hai?”
Tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda, “Ndagha ɗeleewar Musa ƙǝn?”
Ndang ngganda, “Ndagha ɗeleewar Musa a chirethlengga niifa ɗeleewar nǝn nukkun sǝ kalghǝnǝn hai.”
Amma nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, ndǝghǝn, “Ka kakrakid tennun ni ndangna Musa kun kee.
Amma a katǝra ǝna ƙǝshiirha, ‘Faara ǝnaɗǝ hǝshneefa tǝ nuneefa.’
Ndǝn ǝnagha ndǝn na niifa mal chin tǝ man thlǝthlǝɓanggǝn nukkun fa,
sǝri ɗi nanda tsau thlu farha tal. Ɓalwanda sǝri ɓalwa, amma tsau nda tal.
Tsaunǝn kee mbǝ niifa sǝ na ndǝghang ˈya hai wumangna Faara wa.”
Wudnanda hur minda hai, nggǝrgha fatsahayini tsahang mee Yeeso aten laɓarɗiya.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Kala niifa kalgha nukkun hai kakhka pak ǝnanǝn kulafayirha aten nuɗi.
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm, kala nuneefa ndǝkka hai tǝ chimadghǝn, nggǝrghǝn kakh chimarha pak ǝnanǝn kulafayirha.”
Ɗǝfang Yeeso parka wundakhnaya teena
Na farɗasǝ ɓagha fiya ɓa tǝ wanggindan ka a ɗǝfangga Yeeso parka kanda teena, amma fatsahayighǝn na nda a yanang kanda.
Amma nana Yeeso ǝnɗi na nda a ǝnaarha, sǝbgha hurghǝn ɗǝ ndanggǝn kanda, “Malaman wundakhnaya na nggun-ngguchit ɓa nda thlǝmanna ɓa, a yanang ɗun kanda wa. Ƙǝsǝr Kutǝryid Faara yi tur ndanni.
Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, kala niifa thluwawa kutǝryid Faara ƙǝla na wundakhnee ngguchit ǝnaarha wa mbǝ tam kyaarha saɗǝ wa.”
Tǝrgha tǝranggǝn wanggini a fad pǝniyighǝn sǝ ɗǝfang haara nǝn kanda teena fǝrang parka nǝn kanda.
Tǝ ƙǝna
Thliina Yeeso wiirha, ɗagha niifa thlǝmadghǝn ɓa ɓǝrgha hai tǝ waɗedghǝn a mbedghǝn ndanggǝn, “Ka tǝmalǝmnda, ma kamngga tǝta a ǝnee tǝni wal yibrha mbuwa ngwalarha?”
Ndangga Yeeso, “Mani na aah nggi ka niifa? Mbǝ ka niifa sǝ wa ƙǝl Faara katenggǝn.
Sǝnna ˈya ndaana ngyakhrha, ‘A ɓǝlna farha wa, a ǝnanna kulafayirha wa, a ngaarna wa, a nggaɓangna niifa fa ka wa, a huk na farha wa, fǝrang mamnggirha nda muwa tǝ tsu,’ ”
Ndangga niifɗi Yeeso, “Mala, ka nggi ngguchit lafɗi ngyakhkini ya.”

Ƙǝlangga Yeeso niifɗi tǝ yid nggǝmnda ndanggǝn, “Taho ˈyaha tal kamngga a ǝnana, ɗuwaɗǝ ɗa heng ǝnggiwa ɗǝ heu nana tǝghǝn ha fǝrang wuɗǝɓǝlghǝna fa yamiiya, na wal mbǝd ɗǝfǝdghǝn a talara. Tǝrgha a ɓana ɓa, ɓa mbu samadna.”
A mbǝɗiya sǝbgha hur niifɗaɗǝ, wiigha tǝ hurghǝn sǝsǝɓa ɗǝ ƙǝsǝr tǝ ƙǝnani kaan.
Kyahargha Yeeso hai ƙǝlagha ɗǝ, ndanggǝn fatsahayighǝn, “Nǝghǝn pǝɗaghǝn a kyagha tǝ ƙǝna ahu kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ!”
Sǝkna Fatsahayini pathɗi kee fǝrang ǝnwulteena nǝn kanda. Amma nggǝrgha Yeeso ndang kanda, “Wanggina, nǝghǝn pǝɗaghǝn kaan, na a kyagha niifa hu kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ.
Nǝghǝn pǝpa a kyagha thlǝkhmu ɗǝ tǝ kwad libra ma tǝ ƙǝna kyagha hu kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ!”
Nggǝrgha pathɗi chighang ǝnwulteena fatsahayini na nda a tsahang mee ndan ha, “Anaɗǝ kee wunni a wal hǝrǝkrha?”
Ƙǝlangga Yeeso kanda ɗǝ ndǝghǝn, “Niifa tǝ wasa in nǝghǝn pǝɗaghǝn, amma mbǝ tǝ Faara wa, ƙǝsǝr ǝngya heu nǝghǝn pǝpa a fad Faara.”
Tǝrgha ndangga Mbiturus, “Malang ɗan ǝngya heu mbuɗan samadwa.”

Nggǝrangga Yeeso sǝ, “Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, mbǝ niifa sǝ malangga wurighǝn nduwa wan manggighǝn hǝshya nduwa wan manggighǝn nishya nduwa man nduwa chin nduwa wanggighǝn nduwa heeyighǝn ka nggi tǝ laɓar Faara
na ƙǝɗeng wal ƙǝnaghǝn katǝra haru aten, wuraya, wan mangya hǝshya, wan mangya nishya, mangya, waya tǝ kaari-tǝ sǝsaaya. A hu ƙǝshiirha na ɓayi na nda a wal yibrha mbuwa ngwalarha.
Amma fingya ˈwagha kanda ni a nggǝl mee, fingya nggǝlgha mee kanda ni a ˈwaarha.”
Nggǝr Yeeso thlǝk kwaman mǝrrǝghǝn

Kanda hu kwaman ɗǝrha Urshalima ɗǝ, Yeeso a mbee, fatsahayighǝn a na ǝnwulteena, fiya na a mbusamad ndan ƙǝm ƙǝsgha hǝreenga kanda. Nggǝrghǝn ɗǝrha tǝ fatsahayighǝn man patu ɗǝ pǝrang ˈya nǝn kanda ɗǝgha katǝrarha hai tǝghǝn.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ɗǝnǝm Urshalima ɗǝ, ɗǝna nda fǝr Wan Niifa a mamnda firistaya tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha. Na nda a ngwang kumad mǝrra fǝranggǝnda fingya mbuwa Yahudaya.
Na nda a waaghǝn, chahang yakhrha nda fa, tsaɗaghǝn nda, ɓǝlangganda. A kwasamad ɓeena mahan nǝn a nggǝr thliirha sǝ.”
Hwandǝn nda Yakubu tǝ Yahaya
Tǝrgha nda Yakubu tǝ Yahaya wangya Dzabadi, ɓa nda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa ndang ngganda, “Mala, na minnan sǝ a ɗangga kansǝ.”
Tsahang mee nǝn kanda, “Mana minnun a ǝnanggi kun?”
Nggǝrangganda sǝ, “A ɗǝd na hu tsǝnggam kutǝryidwa ɗǝ ngwa tsauka tal ahur nan a yisǝmadwa tal ƙǝm a yikawadwa.”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ ndǝghǝn, “Sǝnggun ˈya nun a hwanda wa! Nun mbang saarha tǝ wuhuleuɗi niya saarha sǝ wa nduwa ǝnang mbaptisǝma nda kun tǝ tur mbaptisǝma ǝneena nda wa?”
Ndang ngganda, “Haˈi, nan a mbang nda.” Ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Nun a mbang saarha tǝ wuhuleu sanna tǝ ƙǝm ǝnang mbaptisǝma nda kun tǝ tur mbaptisǝma ǝneena nda,
amma tsaurha a yisǝmadna tǝ yikawadna mbǝ nggini fǝrghǝn wa. Mbǝyini ya yi fingya ni ngwagha fa.”
Tahad fingya kum sǝknanda kee, sǝbgha hurndan ɗǝ aten nda Yakubu tǝ Yahaya.

Nanǝn kee, aagha Yeeso kanda ɓa heu ndǝghǝn, “Sǝnɗunsǝ fingya tsauka kutǝrya fiya hu ƙǝshidɗiya mbuwa Yahudaya sǝnna nda kanda tǝ kutǝryirha, fingya mamngya ƙǝm kanda ni tǝ sǝsǝmnda ha heu aten fingya na a kamu ndan.
Amma ahur nun nǝn a tsaurha pak. Kala niifa na midghǝn tsauka ndǝghǝnni mamnda tǝta ni tsauka ƙǝla mafad nun.
Kala niifa na midghǝn a nagha a mbee, tǝtani a tsauka mafad kowunni.
Ko nggini na Wan Niifa, ɓawi ɓa mbǝ ka a ǝnee taara nda wa, amma ka ǝnang taara ni fingya tǝ ƙǝm fǝr yiɓǝd nani a meyed fiya hangga.”
Ƙǝnang Yeeso kwamarha
Tǝrgha ɓa nda Djeriko ɓa. Nana Yeeso tǝ fatsahayighǝn heu tǝ fiya na a mbusamad ndan a kyarha sǝ ahur talɗi, na kwamarha sǝ tsau a mii kwamana a hwanda thlǝmnggǝnni Mbartimawus wan Timawus.
Sǝknǝn ndaarha Yeeso tǝ Nadzarat ni na a mbǝraɗǝ, katǝranggǝn huhwaarha hai, “Yeeso! Wan Ndauda! A haɗoyi fa!”
Fiya hangga njarghǝnda, ndang ngganda, “Nggasu hai.”
Sǝkna Yeeso ndǝn, ishgha hai ndǝghǝn, “Ndaman a ɓagha ɓa.” Aaghǝn nda, ndang ngganda, “No wutsǝfayirha fa, thliusǝ nǝghǝn a aah sa.”
Tǝrgha kwamadɗi pǝrgha sǝ, muwanggǝn kootodghǝn ɗǝ, ɗǝgha thlǝmad Yeeso ɗǝ.
Tsahangga Yeeso mee, “Mana midwa a ǝnoyi?” Ndangga kwamadɗi, “Mala, na minnasǝ a namanani hai.”
Ndangga Yeeso, “Ɗuwaɗǝ, fǝrƙǝkafekkid wa ƙǝnoɗǝ.” Tsu a mbǝɗi kee na mana nǝn hai mbusamad Yeeso nǝn.

footnotes.text: PǝɗaghǝnFingya chireelthya yi kaar chik ndan tǝ “tǝƙǝna” nduwa “yanɗi mbǝrsagha tǝ ƙǝna.”
